datasets.title: Colombia Buildings (OpenStreetMap Export)
datasets.description: OpenStreetMap contains roughly 3.0 million buildings in this region. Based on AI-mapped estimates, this is approximately 30% of the total buildings.The average age of data for this region is 3 years ( Last edited 3 months ago ) and 9% buildings were added or updated in the last 6 months. lineage.description: Building footprints were extracted from OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information database for Colombia. The dataset contains approximately 3.0 million mapped buildings with metadata on data currency and completeness estimates. Data are provided in multiple geospatial formats (SHP, KML, GeoJSON, Geopackage) for disaster risk exposure assessment applications.
